name: What is the typical cost range for a bathroom renovation in Orange County?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost range for a bathroom renovation in Orange County?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a bathroom renovation in Orange County can vary significantly based on several factors, including the size of the bathroom, the extent of structural changes, and the quality of materials selected. Minor refreshes might start around $8,000-$15,000, focusing on cosmetic updates like new paint, fixtures, and vanity. A mid-range renovation, involving new tiling, shower, and updated plumbing/electrical, typically ranges from $18,000 to $35,000. High-end remodels with luxury materials, custom cabinetry, and major layout changes can exceed $50,000. A detailed estimate requires an on-site consultation to assess your specific needs and preferences.
acceptedAnswer.description: Bathroom renovation costs in Orange County range from approximately $8,000 for minor updates to over $50,000 for luxury remodels, depending on scope and materials. An on-site consultation provides a precise estimate.
